title: [SOA] Fix "The Order Promising Setup does not exist." crash when setting quote quantity
summary: The Sales Order Agent now handles missing Order Promising Setup gracefully by skipping capable-to-promise calculations and preventing misconfiguration through a setup confirmation dialog on the SOA Setup page.
key_points: Agent no longer crashes with 'Order Promising Setup does not exist' error when setting quote quantities
Capable-to-promise calculation is skipped when Order Promising Setup is absent
Enabling 'Include capable to promise' toggle on SOA Setup page now checks for and offers to create the setup
Graceful degradation shows availability notification instead of error for agents without order promising configuration
No behavior change when Order Promising Setup already exists
